title: 전화로 약속 취소하기: 미안한 마음 전하기
objective: You can call a friend to cancel plans, give a short reason, and use -을/ㄹ 텐데(요).
summary: Learn how to cancel plans with a friend over the phone politely.
setting: Thursday evening. Jieun calls her friend Minsu to cancel their Saturday plans to see a movie.

task.title: Practice cancelling by phone
task.line: Use the dialogue, word list, and the -을/ㄹ 텐데(요) pattern to complete each task.

words.meaning: probably ~, so/but… (a guess about someone's situation, said with care). Past: -았/었을 텐데
words.example: 지금 길이 막힐 텐데 지하철을 타세요.
words.exampleMeaning: The roads are probably jammed now, so take the subway.
The phone call ran long, so I was a little late.
It rained, so we cancelled the camping trip.
I have something urgent, so I'll head out first.

words.meaning: to come up, to happen (a problem or plan)
words.exampleMeaning: A problem suddenly came up with my computer.

words.meaning: to overdo it, to push yourself too hard
words.exampleMeaning: If you have a cold, don't push yourself.
I'm really looking forward to this trip.

dialogue.korean: 여보세요, 민수 씨? 저 지은이에요. 지금 통화 괜찮아요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, Minsu? It's me, Jieun. Is now a good time to talk?
Yes, it's fine. Is something up?

dialogue.korean: 저, 말하기 좀 어려운데요, 토요일 약속을 취소해야 할 것 같아요. 갑자기 회사에 급한 일이 생겼어요.
dialogue.meaning: Um, this is a little hard to say, but I think I have to cancel our Saturday plans. Something urgent suddenly came up at work.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그래요? 주말에도 일하면 많이 피곤할 텐데요. 너무 무리하지 마세요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, really? Working on the weekend too must be really tiring. Don't overdo it.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 그런데 민수 씨가 영화표를 벌써 샀을 텐데 어떡하죠?
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. But you probably already bought the movie tickets. What should we do?
I haven't bought them yet. Don't worry.

dialogue.korean: 다행이네요. 민수 씨도 기대했을 텐데 정말 미안해요. 다음 주에 제가 밥 살게요.
dialogue.meaning: What a relief. You must have been looking forward to it too, so I'm really sorry. I'll buy you a meal next week.

exercises: Change the word in brackets using -을/ㄹ 텐데: 요즘 회사 일 때문에 (바쁘다) ____ 전화해 줘서 고마워요.
Change the word in brackets using the past form -았/었을 텐데: 어제 밤늦게 (도착하다) ____ 오늘은 좀 쉬세요.
Choose the right word: 갑자기 집에 일이 (생겨서 / 취소해서) 오늘 못 가요.
Put the phone call in order: (가) 다음에 제가 커피 살게요. (나) 지금 잠깐 얘기할 수 있어요? (다) 내일 만나기로 한 거, 못 갈 것 같아요.
